$comment: Where the optional voice lives. The package itself carries only the skin and the reference clip; the fine-tuned weights sit in a GitHub release because a 148 MB file is over git's 100 MB per-file limit. scripts/setup-voice.ps1 reads this file, downloads each entry into <FAIRYKIT_HOME>/voice and verifies the sha256 before using it.
